about: One row per distinct finding shape (source, check, kind, rule, cause, page, where) of the accessibility artifacts read through .github/scripts/lib/a11y-ledger.mjs readA11yArtifacts(): the audit of 2026-11-10 on develop at 8b36d609, the A11y nightly run 42763025203 (all seven checks beyond axe and the axe scan) and the Screen reader nightly run 42756854209 (39 scenarios on the four reader projects). The docs rows are one per issue of the docs site scan (tests/a11y/docs/), from its CI run against the develop staging deploy on 2026-11-05, kept from the previous sample because no docs audit had been recorded yet. Regenerate with the collector over a night's artifacts and dedupe by the shape; the triage ratchet in tests/lib/__tests__/a11y-issues.test.mjs reads this file. Every row of the gating axe scan has the kind axe-violation, the one kind the ledger gives that scan's findings, baselined or new.
